name: protonvpn
title: Proton VPN
description: Control Proton VPN from Raycast — see your connection status in the menu bar, and connect, disconnect, or toggle the tunnel.
author: kud

commands.name: status
commands.title: VPN Status
commands.subtitle: Proton VPN
commands.description: Show the Proton VPN connection status in the menu bar, with connect and disconnect actions.

commands.name: toggle
commands.title: Toggle VPN
commands.subtitle: Proton VPN
commands.description: Connect if disconnected, disconnect if connected.

commands.name: connect
commands.title: Connect VPN
commands.subtitle: Proton VPN
commands.description: Start the configured Proton VPN tunnel.

commands.name: open
commands.title: Open Proton VPN
commands.subtitle: Proton VPN
commands.description: Bring the Proton VPN app to the front.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
